constitutional_basis: Art. XV (disclose inconvenient results), Art. XXXI (every correction creates a memory artifact), Art. XI (history is evidence — committed records stand, corrections are additive), Art. XVII/XVIII (the defect class is now pinned by adversarial magnitude guards)
trigger: The R405 external audit demanded explicit arithmetic for the P04 Q_min declaration ('Compute the theoretical floor lumen flow... If it's below, the package has a physics problem to address'). Performing that arithmetic independently exposed that the repository's recorded absolute conductances were physically impossible by ~4-5 orders of magnitude.

the_defect.error: Converting a conductance FROM per-Pa units TO per-mmHg units requires MULTIPLYING by 133.322 (one mmHg = 133.322 Pa, so each mmHg of head drives 133.322x the flow of one Pa). Both functions DIVIDED by 133.322.
the_defect.effect: Every absolute conductance (and therefore every absolute flow emitted by solve_network, whose node pressures are fixed in mmHg so Q = G x dP_mmHg) was 133.322^2 = 17,774.7x too small.
the_defect.physical_sanity_proof: A 0.6 mm ID x 100 mm water column at 10 mmHg passes ~2.5 mL/min by Poiseuille (independent SI derivation). The recorded value implied 1.4e-4 mL/min at 10 mmHg — roughly one eyedropper drop per week. The recorded values were physically impossible; the error was masked because the numbers LOOKED 'physiological' (uL/s scale) and no test asserted a physical magnitude band.
the_defect.why_the_pin_did_not_catch_it: tests/test_r390_reality_loop.py::test_conductance_math_pinned_by_hand_computation pinned 1.4315e-05 with a docstring claiming hand computation — but the 'hand computation' in the test body used the SAME division by 133.322 as the implementation. A verification that repeats the implementation's own unit convention verifies nothing about the convention. (Art. XXXI lesson recorded below.)

unaffected.ratio_based_results: ALL ratio-based verdicts are unaffected because the constant error cancels: the NIST diameter compensation (d_new = d_old x (eta_meas/eta_design)^(1/4)), conductance_restored_ratio = 0.999984, the +44.65% as-built over-drainage discrepancy, G_floor/G_primary = (d_floor/d_primary)^4, BEATS_BASELINE margins, KEEP/KILL geometry-gate decisions, the R396/R401 improvement-loop verdicts.
unaffected.the_nist_correction: The R390 reality event's diameter correction 0.6 -> 0.5471 mm is ratio-based and remains exactly correct.
unaffected.recorded_verdict_fields: No KEEP/KILL/pass/fail state recorded anywhere in the repository changes as a result of this correction.

affected_recorded_artifacts.disposition: HISTORICAL RECORD STANDS (Art. XI — the event record is committed history). This disclosure is the correction of record; the values' ratio structure (restoration 0.999984) was and remains correct.

affected_recorded_artifacts.fields: all total_flow_ml_min / total_flow_ml_s / conductance_ml_s_mmhg values (baseline 9.81831e-06 mL/min; severe-obstruction floor 1.37064e-04; partial 3.72703e-04)
affected_recorded_artifacts.true_values: baseline 0.17453 mL/min; severe 2.43575 mL/min; partial 6.62364 mL/min (x17,774.7 each)
affected_recorded_artifacts.disposition: HISTORICAL RECORD STANDS. BEATS_BASELINE outcome and margins are ratios — unaffected.

FROZEN BASELINE (Art. LIX: the baseline is a measurement of the then-current code and stays frozen). The R401 baseline was frozen WITH the defect; future runs with corrected code must disclose the discontinuity rather than retune.

the_fix.reality_loop.py: return g_m3_per_s_pa * 1e6 * 60.0 * 133.322 (R405; the inverse-direction defect and its disclosure are documented in the function docstring)
the_fix.test_updates: tests/test_r390_reality_loop.py — the pin is re-derived through an INDEPENDENT unit path (flow at 1333.22 Pa converted once, then divided by 10 mmHg) so a direction error cannot cancel; an ADVERSARIAL MAGNITUDE GUARD asserts 0.05 <= G(0.6mm,100mm,1.0) <= 5.0 mL/(min*mmHg) (a unit-direction bug produces 1.4e-5 and fails); the pre-R405 recorded value is pinned as exactly 133.322^2 times too small.
the_fix.test_r394_adjustment: tests/test_r394_benchmark.py::test_bench_15_successful_model_correction — with corrected arithmetic the calibration cancels EXACTLY to err_2_after == 0.0, so the honest zero-denominator guard returns improvement_ratio=None; the assertion now accepts exactly-zero error as the strongest improvement form (the verified property — held-out error collapse — is unchanged and strengthened).

memory_artifact_art_xxxi.lesson: A 'hand computation' that re-derives an expected value using the implementation's own unit convention is not independent verification — it is the implementation verifying itself with extra steps.
memory_artifact_art_xxxi.failed_assumption: That the test's hand-derived constant (1.4315e-5 mL/(min*mmHg)) had been checked against physical magnitude rather than against the code's conversion direction.
memory_artifact_art_xxxi.contaminated_artifacts: The five artifact families listed above; every absolute conductance/flow recorded between R383 and R405.
memory_artifact_art_xxxi.tests_added: (1) independent-unit-path derivation in test_r390 (structure: expected value must come from a DIFFERENT conversion route than the function under test); (2) physical-magnitude adversarial bound (0.05-5.0 mL/(min*mmHg) for the reference geometry); (3) the 133.322^2 correction-factor pin; (4) test_r405_external_audit_response.py re-asserts all of these against the engine functions.

what_this_changes_for_the_packages.P04: The floor lumen's TRUE Poiseuille conductance is 0.254 mL/(min*mmHg) (NIST-corrected geometry) — 6-12x the physiological CSF production rate at minimum head. The safety floor is NOT the flow-limiting element; the Q_min pass rule is satisfiable with large margin when the floor lumen is unobstructed, so the decisive experiment's discriminating power lies in PARTIAL common-cause obstruction (quantified boundary: ~47% effective-diameter reduction tolerance — see LEAD_PORTFOLIO_4/P04/QMIN_FLOOR_FLOW_CALCULATION.json).
what_this_changes_for_the_packages.P11: No P11 record cited absolute conductances; the settling-time model is time-domain and unaffected.
